books.title: Grief, Grace, and Healing: Oracle Deck & Guidebook
books.author: Tanya Carroll Richardson
books.description: A 64-card oracle deck with a 176-page guidebook for anyone living through loss, whether a death, a divorce or another sudden change. The cards carry prompts and gentle messages for moving through grief at one's own pace.

books.title: Forever in My Heart: A Grief Journal
books.author: Tanya Carroll Richardson
books.description: A journal for writing through grief after losing someone close, published by Ulysses Press in 2016.
